title: Contact Us
content:
Contact Customer Service

Our customer service team can assist with product orders, payments, warehouse processing, parcel submission and international shipping questions.

To receive a faster and more accurate response, provide complete information when contacting us.

What Information Should I Provide?

For order-related questions, include:

  • Order number
  • Product name
  • Description of the problem
  • Relevant screenshots

For warehouse-related questions, include:

  • Warehouse order number
  • Domestic tracking number
  • Product information
  • Inspection photo reference

For international parcel questions, include:

  • Parcel number
  • International tracking number
  • Shipping route
  • Description of the delivery issue

For payment questions, include:

  • Payment amount
  • Payment date
  • Payment method
  • Transaction reference
  • Payment result screenshot

Do not provide your password, full bank card number, security code or one-time verification code.

Response Times

Response times may vary during weekends, public holidays, major shopping festivals and periods of high order volume.

Submitting the same request repeatedly through multiple channels may slow down the review process.

Before Contacting Support

Check your account notifications, order status, parcel tracking and Help Center first. Many common questions can be resolved through the information already displayed on the platform.

When contacting customer service, describe the issue clearly and specify the result you expect.
